name: dispatch-gate
description: A soft gate on the main session: reminds it, then refuses once per stretch, to hand work to a subagent; and refuses one Claude subagent per hour past three.

mode.title: Strength
mode.description: off: do nothing; remind: only the reminder after remindAt consecutive execution requests; soft: the reminder and the refusals (one per stretch, one per hour).

remindAt.title: Remind after (consecutive execution requests)
remindAt.description: Consecutive requests the main session spends on its own work before the reminder is injected, once per stretch.

denyAt.title: Refuse after (consecutive execution requests)
denyAt.description: Consecutive requests the main session spends on its own work before one execution call is refused. Once per stretch; the retry runs.

agentPerHour.title: Claude subagents per hour
agentPerHour.description: Claude subagents the main session may dispatch in one rolling hour. The next dispatch is refused once; the retry runs and the hour refuses no more. Delegating to DeepSeek is never counted.

grace.title: Acceptance requests after a dispatch
grace.description: Requests after a dispatch whose tools are only Read, Grep or Glob: reading the work back is free and does not count.
